name: nano-banana-skills
description: A collection of AI agent skills designed for Nano Banana, focusing on advanced image generation capabilities.

skills.name: anime-to-life
skills.description: Transforms anime, art, or 3D rendering images into photorealistic cosplay-style photographs using a specific JSON-based prompt structure.

skills.name: character-reference-sheet
skills.description: Generates character reference sheets with research-backed details. Supports split-screen (default), 2x2, and 3x3 layouts with mandatory front/back views and dynamic poses.

skills.name: figure-to-life
skills.description: Converts figure photos to photorealistic human cosplayer images using a strict JSON-based reasoning mandate.

skills.name: imax-portrait
skills.description: Expands and recomposes images into an IMAX 70mm portrait style (1.43:1 aspect ratio) with high-fidelity Christopher Nolan-esque aesthetics.

skills.name: j-cover
skills.description: Analyzes and reconstructs J-Media and Gravure cover designs using a 4-axis structural layering approach.

skills.name: j-idol
skills.description: Adapts fictional characters into high-fidelity, photorealistic human portraits in the style of J-Idol and Gravure magazine covers.

skills.name: photo-restoration
skills.description: Restores vintage and blurry photos to high-definition 8k images while preserving identity.

skills.name: real-mecha
skills.description: Converts 2D/anime mecha art into photorealistic 3D/real-world visualizations with high-fidelity material textures.

skills.name: j-poses
skills.description: A library of 10 alluring mature Japanese style photography poses for female characters. Use when generating or describing photography-style character poses that emphasize elegance and sophistication.
